reviewSamples.author: Photo of Christopher Cuellar
reviewSamples.text: They did a fantastic job pressure washing my entire house exterior, including the roof, walls, and backyard pavers. They sealed the pavers with two coats and the final product came out very well. Highly responsive, competitive quote, and great to work with. Would highly recommend in the Miramar area.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Keith Vernon
reviewSamples.text: Excellent service.   Very professional,  They arrived on time and took the time to protect our plants.  The office staff was very pleasant and call us to follow up after the job was done.  We would certainly used Aqua Touch again.  Thanks for a job well done. Our home look better than and cleaner than when we moved here 14 years ago.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Stuart Schnellenberger
reviewSamples.text: This company is professional and true to their word. They gave me a great price and did a great job on my roof cleaning without killing any of my plants of lawn just like they promised. Next time I need my roof cleaned, I'll be calling them back without a doubt.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sandra L B
reviewSamples.text: Great Job!! Recently had work done on my property. I would refer and recommend Aqua Touch to all my family and friends as well as word of mouth who needs work done. I found that Aqua Touch was detailed and precise removing all the dirt and water mold. Very professional and knowledgeable explaining the chemicals that was used.
